fusions.name: Burning Slick
fusions.desc: Spits lamp oil that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Scalding Spout
fusions.desc: Blows a jet of steam in a cone 4 tiles ahead that deals 3 damage to everything in it, with a 25% chance to leave each enemy [Burning] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Black Smoker
fusions.desc: Opens a vent in the ground for 12 seconds. Every second it scorches an enemy within 4 tiles, which deals 3 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Burning] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Last Breath
fusions.desc: Each time you kill something, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 8 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
